biotools.summary: CellTarget is an algorithm that uses convex optimization to infer unknown cellular objectives from experimental flux data. It combines Flux Balance Analysis (FBA) with an error-minimization module to accurately predict metabolic objectives in complex systems like mammalian cells.
biotools.name: CellTarget: Convex Optimization for Cellular Objective Discovery
